item.title: Fiona Hardy: Old Games - RTRFM
item.description: Fiona Hardy is a writer, bookseller and reviewer from Melbourne. Her first crime book, Unbury the Dead, was short listed for the Ned Kelly Awards. Danae Gibson chatted with Hardy about Ned Kelly, tennis and ambiguous morality. Her new book, Old Games, is published by Affirm Press.
